subject: general
question: The Planning Commission was the nodal body for central planning in India. Who served as the first Chairman of the Planning Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** served as the first Chairman of the **Planning Commission** of India.
 
• The Planning Commission was established in **1950** by the Government of India for central planning and economic development.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was the first **Prime Minister of India**, serving from 1947 to 1964, and played a pivotal role in shaping India's economy and policies.
 
• The Planning Commission was tasked with formulating **Five-Year Plans** to improve India's economic and social conditions.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan (1951–1956) focused on **agriculture**, irrigation, and energy production.
 
• Under Nehru's leadership, the Planning Commission aimed at achieving **self-reliance** in various sectors and reducing inequalities.
 
• Nehru's vision was influenced by the **Soviet model of planned development**, emphasizing industrialization and modern infrastructure.
 
• The Planning Commission was dissolved in **2014** and replaced by **NITI Aayog**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BR Ambedkar**__

 __
 
• **BR Ambedkar** was the principal architect of the **Indian Constitution** and is celebrated as one of India's greatest social reformers.
 
• He was the first **Law Minister of independent India** and played a crucial role in shaping policies for social justice and equality.
 
• Ambedkar was not directly involved in the Planning Commission but contributed to the socio-economic framework of India.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__
 __
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** was India's first **Deputy Prime Minister** and **Home Minister**.
 
• He is known as the **Iron Man of India** for his role in integrating princely states into the Indian Union.
 
• Patel was not associated with the Planning Commission but played a vital role in India's political consolidation.
 
 
 
• **CD Deshmukh**__
 
 
• **CD Deshmukh** was the first Indian to serve as the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• He later became the **Finance Minister** of India and contributed to financial planning and policy formulation.
 
• Although he worked in areas related to India's economic development, he did not serve as the Chairman of the Planning Commission.
